provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

reaction: A_H+B_D <-> A_D+B_H exchanges one isotope without changing atom or isotope inventories. Each species has exactly the one declared harmonic mode in this controlled comparison.
partition_model: q_vib(nu,T)=exp(-c2*nu/(2*T))/(1-exp(-c2*nu/T)); retain its zero-point factor. Define K_vib=q(A_D)*q(B_H)/(q(A_H)*q(B_D)). Other electronic, translation, rotation and statistical factors are stipulated to cancel; this is a vibrational exchange factor, not a general chemical equilibrium constant.
comparison: Zero-point-only factor omits every thermal denominator. Report its relative error abs(K_zpe/K_vib-1) at500K. Derive the T->infinity limit from the full harmonic partition functions, not from exponentiating only zero-point differences.
scope: No isotope preparation, reaction execution or claim that the omitted contributions cancel in a real chemical system.
